svg.text: Embedded C++20 database with MySQL wire protocol · M6 row-level concurrency
mysql CLI · PyMySQL · SQLAlchemy · JDBC · Go
commit: conflict check → commitSCN → apply versions → WAL → merge expired
Catalog.mu_ (exclusive) — DDL · Table.mu_ (shared/exclusive) — DML vs SELECT
AVL index (PK unique) · row_map_ (int64_t row_id → Row) · versions_ (createSCN/deleteSCN)
① MVCC snapshot isolation — SELECT adds zero locks, reads never block writes
② writeLock_ is narrow — only around commit/rollback, not the entire SQL
③ HSQLDB-style RowAction — writes tracked per session, conflict detected at commit
④ First-writer-wins abort — simple, no latch wait queue, retry via 40001
SELECT / INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE / SHOW / SET
func_names[] whitelist: VERSION · SCHEMA · COUNT · SUM · AVG · MIN · MAX
SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'xxx%' — LIKE pattern parsing
BEGIN / COMMIT / ROLLBACK → StmtKind (real, not placeholder)
ExprContext holds row values + WHERE/HAVING evaluation
Subquery IN — for each outer row, evaluate inner
exec_delete → 1 RowAction(DELETE) · physical delete when deleteSCN=0
exec_select → no RowAction (MVCC reads are snapshot, zero lock)
current: O(N×M) nested-loop JOIN → M6 P2 Index Nested Loop / Hash Join
② conflict check on RowAction (same rowId, committedSCN > 0)
③ allocate commitSCN → update Table versions (deleteSCN/createSCN)
④ WAL append · release row locks · merge_expired_transactions
MVCC visibility: for_each_visible(querySCN) skips rows where createSCN > querySCN or deleteSCN <= querySCN
AVL unique constraint checked during insert (before WAL)
B+Tree (future) → replace AVL for larger range-scan tables
mu_ exclusive · auto checkpoint at shutdown
Startup: read sql.data snapshot → replay sql.wal (truncate on CRC corrupt) → start SCN after last record
Snapshot: TableDef · row_count · AUTO_INCREMENT cursor encoded as snapshot
SQLTiny: ~0.33 ms/op across batch sizes 100 – 5000 (faster per-op than Python overhead)
SQLite : Python timing precision too low for in-memory sqlite3 (ms-level per-call, native-level is sub-μs)
Pre-lock: server crash within 2s (Catalog/Table no mutex)
Post-lock: server alive, consistent final state (1497 rows expected 1500-3)
① JOIN is pure nested loop O(N×M) — M6 P2 needs Index Nested Loop / Hash Join (12s → target <100ms for 200/800)
② MVCC RowAction → mergeExpired path not yet used for table compaction (permanent versions_ memory growth)
